problem: If ${\int }_{C}{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x+y\,\text{d}y+{z}^{3}\,\text{d}z$ is equivalent to ${\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r$ for some piecewise smooth curve $C,$ then $F(x,y,z)=$
worked_solution:
Given a piecewise-smooth path $C$ and a vector field 

$$
F(x,y,z)=P(x,y,z)\,i+Q(x,y,z)\,j+R(x,y,z)\,k
$$

defined on $C,$ we have

$$
{\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r={\int }_{C}P\,\text{d}x+Q\,\text{d}y+R\,\text{d}z
$$

In our case, $P={x}^{2},Q=y,R={z}^{3}.$ Therefore

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{C}({x}^{2}\,i+y\,j+{z}^{3}\,k)\cdot \text{d}r & ={\int }_{C}{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x+y\,\text{d}y+{z}^{3}\,\text{d}z.\end{aligned}
$$

So, $F={x}^{2}\,i+y\,j+{z}^{3}\,k.$
